label: Self-application of the audited cross-history defeat policy (inference)
rule: Apply the policy to the designated basis and eliminate the surviving support that warrant would require
meaning: Taking the designated basis as the debunker’s own ground, the policy undercuts it if its profile and audit meet the stated conditions. If every supporting basis for the conclusion is this one and warrant requires undefeated support, the debunker lacks warrant for that conclusion. No production history, warrant for an actual report, truth value or contradiction follows.
